preconditions.description: The input integer n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
The input n is an integer.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == 2 * (n - 1) if (first_section_valid and second_section_valid) else (len(output_lines) == n - 1 if (first_section_valid or second_section_valid) else 0)
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly the number of lines corresponding to the valid sections: 2*(n-1) if both trees exist, n-1 if only one exists, and 0 if neither exists (though at least one usually exists for n>=2).
The first section is valid if it does not start with '-1'; otherwise it indicates no such tree exists.
The second section is valid if it does not start with '-1'; otherwise it indicates no such tree exists.

postconditions.expression: first_section_valid implies is_valid_tree(first_section_edges, n) and algorithm_answer(first_section_edges, n) != optimal_vertex_cover(first_section_edges, n)
postconditions.description: If the first section is valid, the edges form a tree on n nodes, and Mahmoud's algorithm (min(even_depth_count, odd_depth_count)) yields a value different from the true minimum vertex cover size.

postconditions.expression: second_section_valid implies is_valid_tree(second_section_edges, n) and algorithm_answer(second_section_edges, n) == optimal_vertex_cover(second_section_edges, n)
postconditions.description: If the second section is valid, the edges form a tree on n nodes, and Mahmoud's algorithm yields a value equal to the true minimum vertex cover size.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in first_section_edges if first_section_valid)
postconditions.description: All edges in the first section (if valid) connect distinct nodes within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in second_section_edges if second_section_valid)
postconditions.description: All edges in the second section (if valid) connect distinct nodes within the range [1, n].
The first section (if valid) contains exactly n-1 edges.
The second section (if valid) contains exactly n-1 edges.
